newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Companion to buy New World ceramic units.
newsitem.headline: Companion to buy New World ceramic units.

text.p: Companion Building Material (Holdings) Ltd said on Friday it was in discussions to buy certain ceramic tiles production units from New World Development Co Ltd.
Companion said the purchase would be settled by the transfer of part of its stake in its 60 percent-owned Companion Marble (Holdings) Ltd to New World.
"The company may or may not proceed with the acquisition and...no legally binding agreement has been signed," Companion chairman Siu York Chee said in the statement.
Companion said the purchase was intended to be completed on October 25, but gave no further details.
